items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Is that the same guy they call Skinny?

ctx.x: Oh, he been dead for a long time. I don't know exactly when he died in, but I know he been dead a long time.
Is that the same guy they call Skinny?
Not as I know of. You never did though? I never had no nickname as I know of. I always called him O'Neal average here, that's all.
